=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:4-7, 187-193, 222-233 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: workflow_dispatch is not restricted to the default branch, and the commit-selftest-status job now receives secrets.GH_PAT. A branch-modified copy of the workflow can exfiltrate the PAT.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: reviewers rated it MAJOR (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna) and NIT (minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash), so the highest (MAJOR, mapped to high) is used. The NIT raters noted that the issue prescribes this change and that other workflows in the repo already bind GH_PAT the same way.
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:267 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The ruleset-rejection ::error:: line appends prose directly to token=${token_source}, so the emitted value is "gh_pat;" instead of "gh_pat".
  WHY: This breaks the token=gh_pat|github_token field contract registered in agents.d/8225-nightly-selftest-status-push.md. The existing test asserts only a substring, so it does not catch the regression.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "If the GH_PAT account is also not a bypass actor (candidate 2), item 1 does not help. In that case, deliver the status update as a pull request instead of a direct push: an auto/validation-selftest-status-<date> branch plus a PR with auto-merge." (issue #8225, suggested fix item 4)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml commit-selftest-status job, "Commit validation self-test status" step
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The step only pushes directly to HEAD:${TARGET_BRANCH} and classifies the rejection, with no auto/validation-selftest-status-<date> branch, no PR creation and no auto-merge path. The changelog defers the PR route to operator action. The PR does not establish that GH_PAT is a bypass actor. Reviewers rated it MAJOR (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna) and NIT (minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash), so the highest is used. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash noted it is contingent on the first post-merge run.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:4-7, 223-233 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: workflow_dispatch is not restricted to the main branch, so any user with write access can trigger it on a branch they control. The commit-selftest-status job running there has secrets.GH_PAT in its environment.
  WHY: An attacker can trigger the workflow on a custom branch with a modified step that exfiltrates secrets.GH_PAT.
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:267 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rule-rejection error message appends prose to the token field value (token=${token_source}; ...).
  WHY: Log parsers keyed on the token=gh_pat|github_token shape from agents.d/8225-nightly-selftest-status-push.md read the value as "gh_pat;", which breaks the prefix contract.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: PR-based delivery fallback (auto/validation-selftest-status-<date> branch plus PR with auto-merge) if GH_PAT is not a bypass actor.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml commit-selftest-status job
  Evidence of absence: Only the direct push with GH_PAT and the ruleset classification are implemented. There is no branch creation, PR opening or auto-merge configuration.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:267 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The ruleset-rejection ::error:: line glues prose onto the token= field with ";", so the value is "gh_pat;". The registered contract is token=gh_pat|github_token [rc=], and the sibling push_failed line at 269 is clean.
  WHY: Consumers keying on the registered field shape get the polluted value. The existing test test_commit_step_classifies_ruleset_rejection asserts only the substring "token=gh_pat", so it does not catch this.
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:4-7, 187-193, 222-230 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The PR injects secrets.GH_PAT into the commit-selftest-status step env. workflow_dispatch has no branch restriction, the job's if: always() && github.ref_type == 'branch' fires for any branch, and permissions: contents: write is unchanged.
  WHY: A caller with dispatch and push privilege could modify the workflow on a branch and exfiltrate GH_PAT. The issue requests this change and exploitation needs existing privilege, so severity is bounded, but the capability is not gated.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "If the GH_PAT account is also not a bypass actor (candidate 2), item 1 does not help. In that case, deliver the status update as a pull request instead of a direct push: an auto/validation-selftest-status-<date> branch plus a PR with auto-merge. That is the same pattern update_workflows.yml uses for consumer main branches." (issue #8225, "Suggested fix" item 4)
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml commit-selftest-status job "Commit validation self-test status" step
  Evidence of absence: The step ships only the direct push with secrets.GH_PAT || github.token and the classification log line. There is no branch creation, gh pr create or auto-merge wiring. changelog.d/8225-nightly-selftest-status-push.md:8 defers this to operator action, and nothing establishes that GH_PAT is a bypass actor on the main ruleset.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml line 267. Move the prose to a note= field or a separate echo line so token=${token_source} stays cleanly delimited (about 1 line changed). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:7, 187-193, 229-230 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The manual trigger has no default-branch restriction, and the commit job runs for any branch. The changed step exposes GH_PAT to workflow code from the selected branch.
  WHY: A repository writer can push a branch with modified steps and dispatch that ref to exfiltrate GH_PAT. A fresh runner and persist-credentials: false isolate the fixtures, not the workflow code.
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:267 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The ruleset-rejection message appends prose directly to token=${token_source}, so the emitted value is "gh_pat;" or "github_token;". The field contract is registered in agents.d/8225-nightly-selftest-status-push.md, line 5.
  WHY: A whitespace-delimited key-value parser cannot match the emitted value to the registered contract for ruleset rejections. The other outcomes emit a clean token value.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "If the GH_PAT account is not a bypass actor ... deliver the status update as a pull request instead of a direct push: an auto/validation-selftest-status-<date> branch plus a PR with auto-merge."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml, commit-selftest-status job.
  Evidence of absence: The job still pushes directly to HEAD:${TARGET_BRANCH} and exits on rejection, with no PR branch, PR creation or auto-merge path. The changelog treats the PR route as a future operator response. The PR neither establishes whether GH_PAT is a bypass actor nor implements the conditional fallback.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:6-7, 187-190, 229-230 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The diff replaces the short-lived github.token with the long-lived GH_PAT in a workflow whose dispatch trigger is not ref-restricted. The commit job checks only github.ref_type == 'branch', so a dispatched branch's copy of the step can exfiltrate the PAT.
  WHY: Dispatching on an attacker-controlled branch runs the attacker's step with the PAT bound, whereas previously only the scoped github.token was exposed. Mitigating context: the issue prescribes this change, and the same pattern exists in sync_ai_labels.yml:66 and cancel_on_pr_close.yml:29,76,87. publish-sandbox-images.yml:55 shows a tighter pattern that this workflow does not follow.
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:267 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The ruleset-rejection ::error::VALIDATION_SELFTEST_STATUS line glues prose onto the token field value, so it ships "gh_pat;". The push_failed variant (line 269) and the success line (line 273) emit clean fields.
  WHY: A log consumer keyed on token=gh_pat|github_token from agents.d/8225-nightly-selftest-status-push.md extracts the polluted value, which mismatches the registered contract.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Issue #8225 suggested-fix item 4: "If the GH_PAT account is also not a bypass actor (candidate 2), item 1 does not help. In that case, deliver the status update as a pull request instead of a direct push: an auto/validation-selftest-status-<date> branch plus a PR with auto-merge."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml, commit-selftest-status job / "Commit validation self-test status" step
  Evidence of absence: The diff has only the direct push to HEAD:${TARGET_BRANCH} (line 263) plus rejection classification, with no auto/validation-selftest-status-* branch, PR creation or auto-merge path. The item is contingent: it becomes a real gap only if the first post-merge nightly logs reason=push_rejected_by_ruleset token=gh_pat. The changelog's operator escalation supports that reading.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: (1) Line 189 or line 6: add github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' to the commit job's if:, as in publish-sandbox-images.yml:55 (1 line, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 2). (2) Line 267: end the structured line at token=${token_source} and move the explanation to a note= field or a following echo (1-2 lines, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 1). Overall HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
